title: AIPodo
tagline: Data provider and workers can prove they contribution and ask part of the final payment with hash stored within the blockchain.
description:
AIPoDo "AI Proof Of Data Owernship "ieverages the foundation of blockchain technology to establish traceability and revenue sharing for the work contributed to the creation and training of datasets. AI model require a huge amount of data. And with advanced model like chatgtp/bard/… it need multiple dataset that are provided by multiple sources. Different work has to be done to clear all thoses dataset and provide a fully curated/tagged dataset for a model trainning. 
Data provider and workers can prove they contribution and ask part of the final payment with hash stored within the blockchain.
how_its_made:
We used Scroll and Cello as base blockchain to deploy our Solidity smart contract.
The interface use the graph on those networks to list smart contract info.
We use Wallet connect for the user to connect to the blockchain.
We use Wordcoin to prove that dataset are uploaded by humans
We use unlimits for users to be able to use crypto from fiat.
